name: Words
overview: Scripture reveals the profound power and responsibility inherent in our words. As seen in Exodus 20:7, taking the Lord's name in vain is a serious offense, underscoring the sacredness of speech. Job's reflections in chapters 8 and 38 caution against speaking without knowledge, warning that words can mislead and darken counsel. The psalmist in Psalms 19:14 prays for words and meditations that are pleasing to God, highlighting the importance of speech that honors the Lord. Yet, as Psalms 55:21 illustrates, words can also deceive and conceal malice, reminding believers to guard their tongues carefully.
